paragraphs: His son Rabbi Chanan: Shir HaShirim Rabbah, beginning of chapter 7.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Midrash Rabbah — TE opening scalar of Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:1 explicitly has Rabbi Chanan son of Rabbi Berekhyah of Botzrah. This supports both title expansions and Chanan as the son, without reversing the relationship or importing the teaching.
